shortDescription: Manage HTTPD related settings on a BIG-IP system

options.name: allow
options.description: If you have enabled HTTPD access, specifies the IP address or address range for other systems that can communicate with this system. To specify all addresses, use the value C(all). An IP address can be specified, such as 172.27.1.10. IP ranges can be specified, such as 172.27.*.* or 172.27.0.0/255.255.0.0.

options.name: auth_name
options.description: Sets the BIG-IP authentication realm name.

options.name: auth_pam_dashboard_timeout
options.description: Sets whether or not the BIG-IP dashboard will timeout.

options.name: auth_pam_idle_timeout
options.description: Sets the GUI timeout for automatic logout, in seconds.

options.name: hostname_lookup
options.description: Sets whether or not to display the hostname, if possible.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Sets the minimum HTTPD log level.

options.name: max_clients
options.description: Sets the maximum number of clients that can connect to the GUI at once.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: redirect_http_to_https
options.description: Whether or not to redirect HTTP requests to the GUI to HTTPS.

options.name: ssl_cipher_suite
options.description: Specifies the ciphers the system uses. The values in the suite are separated by colons (:). Can be specified in either a string or list form. The list form is the recommended way to provide the cipher suite. See examples for usage. Use the value C(default) to set the cipher suite to the system default. This value is equivalent to specifying a list of C(ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384,ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA,ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA, ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256,ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA3

options.name: ssl_port
options.description: The HTTPS port on which the system should listen.

options.name: ssl_protocols
options.description: The list of SSL protocols to accept on the management console. A space-separated list of tokens in the format accepted by the Apache mod_ssl SSLProtocol directive. Can be specified in either a string or list form. The list form is the recommended way to provide the cipher suite. See examples for usage. Use the value C(default) to set the SSL protocols to the system default. This value is equivalent to specifying a list of C(all,-SSLv2,-SSLv3).
